text:
[Council File 26-0582]
Motion (Blumenfield, Rodriguez - Hernandez, Jurado) relative to the feasibility of issuing a Request for Information to seek an established animal care and control organization to operate City shelter facilities, and the reassignment of existing Department of Animal Services staff and resources to improve conditions.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted

outcome.text: Council adopted item, subject to reconsideration, pursuant to Council Rule 51 (Aug 21, 2026); Council action final
